Burrito with freshly made pico de gallo

1.5LB of Meat (Skirt steak is my favorite and what we'll assume here but it can be any meat) 5 Roma Tomatoes 1 Jalapeno 1 Serrano 1/2 a red onion 3 limes 3 leafs of lettuce 1 avocado some cilantro sour cream Mild white Mexican cheese.
1 tbsp Olive oil Salt pepper cumin Burrito sized tortillas

Trim fat from skirt steak not all of it but sometimes it has too much use your judgement.

Season the steak with salt and pepper and some cumin as well as the juice of 1/2 lime. Let is coem to room temp while you make the pico.

Dice the tomato, onion, jalapeno, and Serrano. add to large bowl season with salt pepper and juice of the other half of that lime from earlier and juice of 1 additional lime. Add about 1/4 to 1/2 tsp of cumin that's been toasted briefly and the 1 tbsp of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands. place in refrigerator.

Pre heat oven to 350 F.

Get a cast iron pan stupid hot... No not yet...Water next to it should be boiling...there ya go that's hot enough.

Cook the steak 1 -2 min per side for rear to medium rare depending on thickness of your steak. That's where I like it you can go longer if you want it more well done.

Remove steak from pan and wrap in tin foil to let rest.

Shred lettuce

rip apart cilantro bonus points if it came from your herb garden because fresh cilantro is only rivaled by crack cocaine in it's awesomeness and addictiveness .

slice avocado

section last lime

Remove pico, sour cream and cheese from fridge. (grate the cheese if you bought good cheese)

throw tortilla in oven at 350

dice perfectly cooked and rested steak(s)

remove tortilla from oven.

add steak, cheese, pico, lettuce, avocado, and sour cream to tortilla in that order.

Wrap

eat with a side of salsa verde, call your mother, and make love to your wife.
